predictions.title: No restoration of the pre-February order through winter
predictions.claim: Hormuz stays contested; Bab el-Mandeb stays under Houthi pressure.
predictions.mechanism: Loop P2 needs sustained pressure. Houthi entrenchment (trenches, islands, a 'ship transit administration') signals staying, not raiding. Winter maximizes transmission into European political pain.
predictions.falsifier: Full reopening of both waterways + Houthi withdrawal by end of 2026.
predictions.auto: Broken if BOTH chokepoints' 30-day mean transits are at least 80% of their 2025 baseline on or before 2026-12-31. Wobbling if either is at least 60%. Houthi withdrawal needs a manual verdict.

predictions.title: Oil elevated and volatile: Brent $90–130 through Q1 2027
predictions.claim: Brent trades in a $90–130 band, spiking on escalation and pulling back on diplomacy.
predictions.mechanism: The band is the contest between the structural risk premium (P2 loop) and the price mechanism (N2: shale, SPR, demand destruction).
predictions.falsifier: Brent sustains below $80 for 30 consecutive trading days.
predictions.auto: Broken on 30 consecutive Brent closes below $80. Wobbling if any close in the last 30 trading days left the $90–130 band.

predictions.title: Dedollarization in energy trade accelerates measurably by end of 2027
predictions.claim: Non-dollar oil settlement and yuan settlement rise; the dollar's reserve share erodes.
predictions.mechanism: Loop P1: high prices raise the incentive to leave dollar rails, and every weaponization episode recruits new defectors.
track: USD share of FX reserves (IMF COFER, quarterly)
CNY share of FX reserves (IMF COFER)
predictions.falsifier: Dollar share of reserves rises back above 59% and holds.
predictions.auto: Broken if USD share is above 59% for two consecutive quarters. Wobbling if the latest USD share is higher than it was four quarters earlier.

predictions.title: US deepens involvement without choosing full war
predictions.claim: Intel/targeting support and limited strikes; no sustained direct war with Iran or the Houthis.
predictions.mechanism: C1, the credibility trap: the US must respond, but midterms, force strain, fiscal limits and N3 hold it back.
predictions.falsifier: Either direction: full US withdrawal from the theater, OR a sustained bombing campaign / ground commitment.

predictions.title: AI capabilities concentrate; gains accrue to states and large capitals first
predictions.claim: Frontier AI stays compute-concentrated; military AI investment surges.
predictions.mechanism: Loop P3 plus C3: in wartime the diffusion-vs-control contradiction resolves toward control.
track: Open-weight lag behind the closed frontier (months)
predictions.falsifier: A genuinely open-weights model matches the closed frontier within 6 months of release.

predictions.title: Interregnum, not succession: no single successor hegemon by 2028
predictions.claim: Fragmented transactional blocs, regional hegemons and hedging, not a clean Chinese century.
predictions.mechanism: The provision gap: rival architectures take years to build (delays).
predictions.falsifier: A rival settlement/security architecture handles more than 15% of global trade at scale.

predictions.title: Europe is the weakest link; political breaks appear there first
predictions.claim: At least one European government faces a survival-level crisis over energy costs, or a far-right breakthrough explicitly fueled by energy misery.
predictions.mechanism: P2 transmits hardest where dependence is highest and fiscal room thinnest. Winter amplifies it. Revised 2026-09-28 after red-team fact-check: the core warning (historically low seasonal storage, crisis-level prices, record diesel assessments, far right leading polls in France and Germany) is confirmed, but exposure scoring and several supporting figures in the research brief were overstated. Status: plausible, but insufficiently defined without the break criteria in the falsifier.
predictions.falsifier: None of the following occur through spring 2027: (a) coalition collapse, lost confidence vote, or leadership replacement over energy costs; (b) far-right governing agreement or national election victory; (c) enacted energy-policy reversal with implemented supply arrangements; (d) concrete obstruction or reversal of a specified joint EU/NATO policy.

predictions.title: Russia probes NATO's eastern flank as US entanglement deepens
predictions.claim: Moscow runs probes testing whether Article 5 credibility holds while Washington is tied down in the Middle East.
predictions.mechanism: Overstretch opportunism: every carrier group, interceptor stockpile, and aid dollar committed to CENTCOM is bandwidth unavailable for NATO's eastern flank. No master plan required. Baseline recalibrated 2026-09-28: September 2025 already saw the first-ever NATO shoot-downs of Russian assets over allied territory and two Article 4 invocations in two weeks, so probing is the baseline, not the escalation.
predictions.falsifier: No incident through 2027 above the recalibrated bar: manned-aircraft engagement, Article 5 invocation, casualties, or kinetic response beyond drones.

predictions.title: Taiwan faces heightened gray-zone pressure without full invasion
predictions.claim: Beijing intensifies coercion — coast-guard pressure, air and maritime incursions, economic leverage — while stopping short of invasion or full blockade, exploiting the US carrier gap in the western Pacific.
predictions.mechanism: The same overstretch logic as P8 applied to the Pacific: with US carriers and interceptors committed to CENTCOM, the cost of gray-zone escalation falls. The window is open now — zero US carriers in the western Pacific in August 2026; PLA coercion already shifting from air sorties to coast-guard pressure with a new front east of Taiwan — not a future risk.
track: PLA air/naval sortie counts around Taiwan
Coast-guard patrol density east of Taiwan
US carrier positions in the western Pacific
predictions.falsifier: No gray-zone escalation above the 2026 baseline through 2027: no CCG-led quarantine or customs-inspection regime at scale, no seizure or blockade of Kinmen/Matsu, no 200+-sortie exercise, no declared closure of waters east of Taiwan.
